steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A client's page in the ConstructHUB CRM has Quick actions, for the jobs you do most.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Open a client. We'll use Rafael Quintanilla.

steps.caption: Quick actions
steps.narration: Quick actions sit right under the client's details.

steps.caption: Schedule appointment
steps.narration: Schedule appointment books a visit.

steps.caption: Title
steps.narration: Give it a title.

steps.caption: Starts
steps.narration: Set when it starts,

steps.caption: Ends
steps.narration: and when it ends.

steps.caption: Schedule
steps.narration: Then choose Schedule.

steps.caption: On the page and the calendar
steps.narration: The visit is on this page, and on your calendar.

steps.caption: New estimate
steps.narration: New estimate starts a bid for this client.

steps.caption: The estimate form
steps.narration: It opens for this client. Give it a title and add your lines.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: We'll close it for now.

steps.caption: Add to pipeline
steps.narration: Add to pipeline starts a new project for them.

steps.caption: Project name
steps.narration: Name the job,

steps.caption: Create project
steps.narration: and choose Create project.

steps.caption: A new project
steps.narration: The project is on this page, and in the Lead column of your pipeline.

steps.caption: Take a payment
steps.narration: And Take a payment opens the payment form for this client.

steps.caption: The invoice
steps.narration: Their open invoice is already picked.

steps.caption: Create payment link
steps.narration: Create payment link makes a secure link they can pay online.

steps.caption: Record a payment
steps.narration: Or record a check or cash they already gave you.

steps.caption: Close
steps.narration: We'll close this one too.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find Quick actions on every client's page, under Clients.

youtube.title: How to use quick actions on a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Quick actions on a client's page in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will book a visit, start an estimate, add a project to your pipeline and open the payment form without leaving the client. The walkthrough uses a demo company and demo clients.
